verdict.rationale: Brex documents automatic receipt matching: uploaded receipts are matched to existing expenses, and the API offers 'upload receipt and match automatically'. Its AI assistants are described as 'fetching receipts', and a review agent 'follows up with anyone out of compliance', which loosely covers the nudge. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of e-receipts pulled from named integrations (e.g. email or merchant apps), evidence that nudges fire only when a receipt is genuinely missing, and independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
